name: Consumer Subject
description: Consumer Subject (CS) segment schema — iscore regulatory report

fields.name: 1. Segment Identifier
fields.description: Must contain the value CNCS

fields.name: 2. Data Provider ID
fields.description: 10 Alpha Numeric Digits

fields.name: 3. Data Provider Branch ID
fields.description: Branch Ids

fields.name: 4. Credit Facility Account Number
fields.description: Unique Credit Facility Account Number/card number

fields.name: 5. Data Provider Identification Code for Subject
fields.description: Identification Code assigned to the Subject by Data Provider

fields.name: 6. Previous Data Provider Identification Code for Subject
fields.description: Defaulted to blank/NULL. Used in migration process, ONLY with coordination with iscore

fields.name: 7. Bureau Subject Code
fields.description: Bureau Subject Code issued by Egyptian Credit Bureau (iscore) to the Subject

fields.name: 8. National ID
fields.description: National ID issued by the Authority. Required when Citizenship = 054 (Egypt)

fields.name: 9. Identification Code 1
fields.description: Identification Code 1 issued by Authority specified. Required when Citizenship is not 054

fields.name: 10. Issuing Authority 1
fields.description: Code of the Authority that issued Identification Code 1. Required when ID Code 1 is reported

fields.name: 11. Identification Code 1 Expiry Date
fields.description: Date of expiry of the Identification Code 1

fields.name: 12. Identification Code 2
fields.description: Identification Code 2 issued by Authority specified

fields.name: 13. Issuing Authority 2
fields.description: Code of the Authority that issued Identification Code 2. Required when ID Code 2 is reported

fields.name: 14. Identification Code 2 Expiry Date
fields.description: Date of expiry of the Identification Code 2

fields.name: 15. Identification Code 3
fields.description: Identification Code 3 issued by Authority specified

fields.name: 16. Issuing Authority 3
fields.description: Code of the Authority that issued Identification Code 3. Required when ID Code 3 is reported

fields.name: 17. Identification Code 3 Expiry Date
fields.description: Date of expiry of the Identification Code 3

fields.name: 18. Language ID
fields.description: Identifies whether content for Subject Name and Address is English, Arabic or Both

fields.name: 19. Subject First Name (English)
fields.description: Subject first name in English.

fields.name: 20. Subject Middle Name (English)
fields.description: Subject middle name in English.

fields.name: 21. Subject Last Name (English)
fields.description: Subject last name in English.

fields.name: 22. Subject First Name (Arabic)
fields.description: Subject first name in Arabic.

fields.name: 23. Subject Middle Name (Arabic)
fields.description: Subject middle name in Arabic.

fields.name: 24. Subject Last Name (Arabic)
fields.description: Subject last name in Arabic.

fields.name: 25. Previous First Name of Subject (English)
fields.description: Previous first name of subject in English

fields.name: 26. Previous Middle Name of Subject (English)
fields.description: Previous middle name of subject in English
